synthesis.keySignal: Standardized C-CDA/PDF output is comprehensive in names but not proven field-complete across all EHI modules.
synthesis.operationalImplication: Useful for downstream systems that already parse CCD/CCDA/PDF, but high normalization effort is likely for custom analyses.
